subject: french
title: Lifestyles and Self
welcome_lead: The IBDP theme of Identities explores who we are. Lifestyles, beliefs and values define the self we present in French.
meta_desc: IBDP French: Identities theme — lifestyles, beliefs and self-presentation.
final_note: Identity in language is more than words — it is how you live in them.

concepts.def: Lifestyle — how a person lives day to day.
Values — principles guiding behaviour and choices.
Identity — the sense of who one is.
Belonging — connection to a group or place.

walkthroughs.body_html: To describe a lifestyle: Je mene une vie equilibree (I lead a balanced life). For health: Je fais du sport regulierement. Connectors like de plus and par contre structure your answer.
Use the subjunctive after il est important que: Il est important que nous respections les autres. Sentences with pour moi personalise your stance.
For Identities prompts, plan two main ideas and a counter-position. Use d'une part... d'autre part and a clear conclusion: En conclusion, je pense que....
